page_title: VAL 2-0 LEG | Valencia v Leganes 09/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Dani Raba (Leganes) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
90+4' Javi Guerra (Valencia) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Leganes.
90+2' Dani Raba (Leganes) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

86' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) jinks his way past two defenders and from the edge of the box has an effort which goes just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
85' Leganes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

84' A sweet pass finds Duk (Leganes) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Giorgi Mamardashvili is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
83' Dani Raba (Leganes) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
82' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Giorgi Mamardashvili to dive and make a save.
82' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
81' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) commits a foul during an attacking move.
77' Substitution. Enzo Barrenechea makes his way off the pitch and Pepelu (Valencia) comes on as his replacement.
77' Here is a change. Andre Almeida is going off and Carlos Corberan gives the last tactical orders to Fran Perez (Valencia).

74' What a great effort! Javi Guerra (Valencia) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
73' Borja Jimenez prepares a substitution. Miguel de la Fuente is replaced by Duk (Leganes).
73' Substitution. Juan Cruz will be replaced by Diego Garcia (Leganes).

73' Ivan Jaime finds Umar Sadiq (Valencia) after some good work, but from the edge of the box he skews his attempted shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
72' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Diego Lopez leaves the pitch and Ivan Jaime (Valencia) comes on.

71' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Valencia are going to take it.
69' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
69' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
68' Andre Almeida (Valencia) was too forceful with his tackle and Guillermo Cuadra interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) will replace Darko Brasanac.

66' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) loses his marker in the box from the resulting corner, times his jump well but flashes his close-range header well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
66' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Valencia.

65' Diego Lopez (Valencia) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the left side of the goal, but Marko Dmitrovic is well positioned to make a comfortable save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Valencia.

63' Jose Gaya (Valencia) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
59' Borja Jimenez is stunned as referee Guillermo Cuadra shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
59' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Hugo Duro will be replaced by Umar Sadiq (Valencia).
58' Mouctar Diakhaby will be replaced by Yarek Gasiorowski (Valencia).
58' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

55' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
52' The attendance for today's match is 42314.

50' A rebound sits up nicely for Diego Lopez (Valencia) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, balloons high over the bar and out for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
49' Diego Lopez (Valencia) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
49' The ball goes out for a corner. Valencia can continue in their attacking effort.
46' Borja Jimenez has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) comes on the pitch for Renato Tapia.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
41' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Diego Lopez tees up Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Marko Dmitrovic.
40' A corner kick by Valencia is thwarted by the well prepared Marko Dmitrovic (Leganes).
40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Valencia comes to nothing. The ball goes out of play. Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
33' Leganes will take a corner kick.
30' 1 - 0 Goal! Andre Almeida pulls the ball back for Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) on the edge of the box, and he beats the keeper with a fine strike low into the middle of the net. 1:0.
29' The referee points to the corner flag and Valencia will take a corner.
29' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
25' Yellow card. Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

25' Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Guillermo Cuadra no option but to blow his whistle. Leganes have been awarded a free kick.

24' Javi Guerra (Valencia) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
23' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
23' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Yvan Neyou (Leganes). Guillermo Cuadra saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. Valencia are awarded the free kick.

19' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
14' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

12' Diego Lopez (Valencia) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.

11' A dangerous towering header by Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
11' Valencia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

11' Hugo Duro (Valencia) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner.
10' Borna Barisic (Leganes) doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Adria Altimira comes onto the pitch to replace him.
9' It doesn’t look good for Borna Barisic (Leganes); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!

7' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.

4' Dani Raba (Leganes) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
3' Darko Brasanac (Leganes) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a great save to stop his effort.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Leganes will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Guillermo Cuadra.
